newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: RUGBY UNION-WESTERN SAMOA STEAMROLL MUNSTER IN TEST WARM-UP.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-WESTERN SAMOA STEAMROLL MUNSTER IN TEST WARM-UP.

text.p: Western Samoa steamrolled Irish provincial side Munster 35-25 on Saturday, scoring five tries in a morale boosting performance ahead of Tuesday's rugby union test against Ireland.
Western Samoa centre Terry Fanolua scored either side of the interval, while flanker Sene Ta'ala, Mark Fatialofa and winger Pailate Fili also ran in tries.
Fa'avaivai Tanoai finished with 10 points through two conversions and two penalties.
Munster's Mike Lynch scored two tries and his team's third five-pointer came from a penalty try.
Western Samoa's victory was marred by the sending-off in the 53rd minute of hooker Trevor Leota for a high tackle.
